stem.text: A miniature loudspeaker, initially at rest, falls vertically from a window in a high building. When the speaker has fallen a distance of $10.0\,\text{m}$, it emits a very short pulse of sound of constant frequency $256\,\text{Hz}$ in all directions. The pulse of sound, travelling at a speed of $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, is heard by a person leaning out of the window.
What is the frequency of the pulse of sound heard by the person?
